# GitHub Issue Labels

Use the following standardized label taxonomy to organize the TaintFlow issue backlog.

---

| Label Name | Color | Description |
| :--- | :---: | :--- |
| **bug** | `#d73a4a` | Outlines a verified parser failure, crash, or engine issue. |
| **false-positive** | `#fef2c0` | TaintFlow reports a path that is not exploitable or safe. |
| **false-negative** | `#1d76db` | Analyzer fails to detect a valid vulnerability path. |
| **rule-request** | `#006b75` | Request for a new CWE check pattern or sanitizer model. |
| **documentation** | `#0075ca` | Improvements or corrections to `/docs` markdown files. |
| **precision-audit** | `#b60205` | Task related to validation harness regression or baselines. |
| **good first issue** | `#7057ff` | Simple bugs or docs issues suitable for new contributors. |
| **release-blocker** | `#b60205` | High-priority stability or recall issue that blocks a release. |
